mechanism_findings.finding: Historical Retina implemented a real two-tier pattern library: synthetic GoL archetypes plus data-driven cluster centers learned from real-image 50-dimensional dynamical signatures; inference performs cosine nearest-center matching and emits the learned cluster's phrases above a high similarity gate.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Direct ancestor of MVC-0 prototype/centroid familiarity routing, but not yet user-scoped or semantically authoritative.

mechanism_findings.finding: The learned dictionary builder extracted multi-channel GoL signatures over the evaluation corpus, L2-normalized them, fit k=32 K-means clusters, linked cluster members back to source images and inherited cached oracle phrases from member images, with a fallback to synthetic archetype labels.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Reusable-with-adaptation pattern: frozen/reusable visual representation -> prototype/centroid memory -> deterministic versioned readout. Oracle labels cannot be treated as trusted current user labels without provenance gates.

mechanism_findings.finding: The offline iteration loop reused cached oracle phrases, reran Retina-side coverage, ranked misses and compared iterations without repeated oracle calls, creating a teacher-reference -> miss analysis -> representation/vocabulary/threshold update -> replay cycle.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Strong precursor to bounded cyclic learner evaluation and frozen replay, but historical updates were predominantly offline/global rather than per-user online candidate promotion.

mechanism_findings.finding: Retina separated expensive first-use initialization from steady-state inference through lazy singleton models and explicit warm-up; the API accepted bytes/path/URL and returned structured evidence rather than only prose.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Reusable runtime pattern for keeping adaptive visual learning operationally unobtrusive and for preserving structured sensor evidence.

mechanism_findings.finding: Historical calibration reacted to concrete user feedback by hedging low-confidence labels and surfacing alternatives instead of forcing a single identity.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Supports current KNOWN_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION/AMBIGUOUS/UNKNOWN routing semantics, but historical confidence rules were not a complete open-set contract.

measurement_findings.finding: An early honest hard-set report measured only 35.3% strict phrase coverage on 12 adversarial images and 47.5% on 10 easy images; it explicitly rejected an earlier unsupported 55->95% memory claim.

A later five-round dictionary protocol reported 82.4% aggregate held-out phrase coverage over 47 images/1,196 phrases; adding the learned pattern dictionary moved a fixed-set architecture progression from 78.9% to 87.5% (+8.6 percentage points).
measurement_findings.caveat: The metric mixed lexical and CLIP evidence and is not equivalent to current open-set identity accuracy. The final 99.1% small round must not be generalized.

measurement_findings.finding: Realistic negative controls exposed major threshold sensitivity: at CLIP threshold 0.20 realistic false-positive rate was reported around 43.3%, while at 0.22 it fell to about 13.6% with lower recall.
measurement_findings.current_mapping: Current MVC familiarity gates must be calibrated on realistic user/OOD negatives; a lenient similarity score cannot be promoted to semantic truth.

measurement_findings.finding: Later reports reached 94.6% CLIP-lenient coverage at threshold 0.20 and reported 87.8% strict substring after broad phrase emission, but also document that 0.20 represents weak visual cues and that 0.22 produced only 66.3% in the same sweep.
measurement_findings.current_mapping: Anti-Goodhart warning: distinguish recognition signal, surfaced text coverage, calibrated identity confidence and task correctness.

negative_results_and_failure_modes: YOLO's 80-class boundary left many art/artifact concepts without object detections, preventing region-conditioned stages from firing.
YOLO hallucinations on art/AI could seed downstream region-caption confabulations; one documented Kandinsky case became worse after the extra stage.
OCR failed on stylized/painted text; global CLIP vocabulary had long-tail gaps; fine compositional binding was weak.
Metric inflation can arise by broad phrase emission and lenient CLIP thresholds even when downstream semantic correctness has not improved proportionally.

Historical dictionary learning did not provide the current contract's per-user provenance tiers, autonomous candidate-vs-current shadow promotion, rollback, version migration or robust open-set rejection.

current_architecture_delta.recommended_discriminating_test: At H1, compare MVC-0 centroids using reusable CLIP/DINO features against the historical GoL-signature centroid family on recurring user-specific classes plus realistic OOD/near-neighbor negatives. Preregister known-class accuracy, open-set AUROC/FPR at target recall, calibration, retention under sequential additions, CPU/RAM/update cost and routing savings. Keep labels provenance-tiered and replay the same frozen split for every candidate.
